'''Fort Maximus''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[O'reen]], in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The city was heavily guarded as the location of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] primary [[Army/Legends|military]] base. The planetary leader, the [[Magnus (title)|Magnus]], lived in an [[Magnus's estate|estate]] in the city. Much of Fort Maximus's population was made up of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="UR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> Most of Fort Maximus's food came from [[Farm/Legends|farms]] located around another city, [[Epsilon Garrison]].<ref name="UR" />
